PRIVACY POLICY · 7 OCTOBER 2026

We collect nothing.

DunnyMaster does not collect, transmit, sell or share personal data. There are no accounts, analytics, advertisements, tracking technologies or third-party SDKs.

Information stored on your device

Active-session timestamps, preferences, completed-session records and local game records are stored only on your device and in the app’s private app-group container so the app and its Live Activity can work together.

Notifications and Live Activities

If you grant permission, DunnyMaster schedules local notifications and displays a Live Activity. The timer does not depend on notification delivery. Gama Dynamics does not receive notification or Live Activity data.

Apple services

Apple may process diagnostic, App Store or device information according to your Apple settings and Apple’s own privacy policies. Gama Dynamics does not receive this information through DunnyMaster.

Children

DunnyMaster does not knowingly collect information from anyone, including children, because it does not collect information at all.

Contact

Privacy questions can be sent to jorgealbarracin00@gmail.com.
